materialFindings.summary: Public research did not surface a material exact-match Reeris UI / ReerisUI software framework, design system, developer tool, SaaS product or technology company conflict.
Reeris is a coined founder-derived brand combining Revaz and Eristavi, improving distinctiveness compared with the previous Reva UI working name.
The intended @reeris npm scope and package names have not yet been successfully reserved or authoritatively verified live.
The preferred Reeris/ReerisUI domains have not yet been successfully reserved or authoritatively verified with a registrar/RDAP source.

No material exact REERIS UI software trademark surfaced in public research, but formal similarity clearance in relevant software/technology classes remains pending and this research is not legal advice.

decision: Proceed with the Reeris UI rename throughout the pre-1.0 codebase while keeping the public-publication gate open until npm/domain reservation and formal trademark clearance are completed.
